clauses.text: A dispute can only be raised for a posted transaction. Pending transactions must post first.
The cardholder must report the transaction within 60 days of its posting date.
Only one open dispute may exist per transaction. If one exists, share its status instead of opening another.
Before raising a dispute, confirm with the cardholder that they did not make or authorise the transaction.
When a dispute is raised, give the cardholder the case reference and explain that a provisional credit decision is made within 10 business days and the investigation can take up to 90 days.
Ask whether the card is still in the cardholder's possession. If not, or if other unknown charges exist, treat the card as compromised and escalate to the fraud team.
